5. Cancellation, Rescheduling & Program Changes
Cancellations by Dive Komodo
We reserve the right to cancel operations for safety or operational reasons. We will offer alternatives (different boat/dates) or a trip refund. We are not liable for external costs including flights or accommodation—comprehensive travel insurance is highly recommended. Cancellations by Guest
Deposits are non-refundable. Part-refunds for amounts exceeding the deposit depend on notice given prior to scheduled departure:
Day Trips & Courses: 20+ hours (30% forfeited), 19 hours or less (100% forfeited).
Liveaboard & Charters: A three-day cooling-off period applies to the activity deposit when the booking is made more than 14 days before departure. Komodo National Park tickets, third-party charges and transaction fees already incurred remain non-refundable. After the cooling-off period, cancellations made more than 14 days before departure will result in the forfeiture of the 30% activity deposit. Any amount paid above the deposit may be refunded after deducting non-refundable costs. Cancellations made 14 days or fewer before departure will result in 100% forfeiture of the total booking amount.
3rd Party Items / Services: Follows the specific provider’s terms.No Shows & Late Arrivals
We wait up to 20 minutes past the meeting time before departing. Missing a departure entirely results in a 100% forfeiture of the trip amount. Program Changes & Management Discretion
Specific dive sites are never guaranteed and itineraries may alter due to weather, safety, or low participation. Management reserves discretion to adjust refund policies based on individual circumstances and cost offsets.
🌊
6. Force Majeure & External Disruptions
The Company is not liable for any failure to perform its obligations if such failure is caused by events beyond our reasonable control (Force Majeure), including but not limited to natural disasters, extreme weather conditions, government restrictions, port closures, volcanic activity, or civil unrest.
In such events, the Company reserves the right to alter itineraries or cancel trips. Refunds or rescheduling options will be provided at the Company’s absolute discretion, and the Company shall not be responsible for any consequential losses, including flights, accommodation, or missed tours.
